articles.title: Inflation versus household budgets: Which expenses are rising fastest?
articles.summary: Food and beverages, which account for 36.8% of the CPI basket, recorded inflation of 7.4% in September, up from 5.7% in August. Vegetables and pulses inflation surged to 9.2%, compared with 1.6% a month earlier, making them a key contributor to the increase in headline inflation.

articles.title: India exports 18-coach LHB train to Bangladesh with CCTVs and baby care rooms
articles.summary: Bangladesh Railway placed a fresh order through RITES in 2024 for the manufacture and supply of 200 broad-gauge passenger coaches. The order covers seven different variants and further deepens the association between the two organisations.

articles.summary: Consumer durable loans have aided lenders in establishing credit histories for younger borrowers over recent years. Two-wheeler loan delinquencies have significantly declined to 1.4% in June 2026 from 2.7% in June 2019.
